text: [issue by Klisz] **Describe the bug** If the Flywheel backend is set to "flywheel:off", the game crashes whenever a kindled liquid blaze burner is on screen. This does not occur with base Create blaze burners, nor with smouldering liquid blaze burners (I haven't tested with seething), with Flywheel backend on instancing or indirect, or on 1.20.1. **To Reproduce** - Run the command `/flywheel backend off` - Place a blaze burner - Give the blaze burner a straw - Give the blaze burner lava **Additional context** - Mod version: neoforge-1.21.1-1.4.2 - NeoForge version: 21.1.186 - Create version: 6.0.6 latest.log, from a test instance with no mods other than Create and Crafts & Additions themselves: https://mclo.gs/Oh5F3LD crash report: https://mclo.gs/E7YJTgk [comment by rsp4jack (none)] Can confirm under CC&A 1.5.1, create 6.0.6, NF 21.1.193.
